default_spread_impact_bps.note: Per side at any size, for assets with no book on this venue, or none the sampler could measure.

tier1_taker.note: Section 5's Kraken Pro figure, not measured. A sensitivity.

tier2_taker.note: Not measured, and not in section 5, which names only the other three.

tier3_maker.note: Section 5's Kraken Pro figure, not measured. A sensitivity: the base case never assumes maker fills.

tier3_taker.note: Section 5's Kraken Pro figure, not measured. The base case.

floor_bps.note: Per side, on spread and impact after the history multiplier.

fx_conversion_bps.note: Per trade on a GBP book, because the account holds USD. Not a book spread, so no multiplier and no floor.

history_multipliers.note: On spread and impact, not fees. Each period runs up to but not including its until_utc.

method.book: Amendments 1 and 5: the account holds USD, so a USD book pays no FX and a GBP book pays fx_bps. At GBP 5,000, the USD book against the GBP book plus fx_bps, with a tie going to USD. A book that can't fill GBP 5,000 can't be chosen. If neither can, USD.
method.can_fill: A sample fills a size only if both sides fill. A book can fill a size if at least 80% of its samples do, and other sizes are null. In the median, a sample that can't fill counts as dearer than any that can.
method.one_way_cost: fee + fx_bps + max(floor, multiplier x spread and impact at the size). See research/harness/costs.py.
method.panel_names: Amendment 6: the book a panel's name uses where it isn't the name itself, and null where this venue's book of that name is another coin. A later part X~2 is the same coin as X unless listed.
method.samples: This venue's rows only. Other venues' rows, rows holding an error and rows that fail validation aren't samples.
method.spread_impact_bps: Median across samples of (buy + sell) / 2. The sampler measures both from the mid, so the half-spread is already inside and isn't added again. It excludes fx_bps.
